intro: Larnaca learner drivers in 2026 have a strong choice of instructors, with seven local schools covering every neighbourhood from the salt lake to Oroklini.

schools.ed71431a0fbacba7: Driving School Panikkos Iakovou Larnaca (Scholi Odigon Panikkos Iakovou Larnaka) sits at the top of the city rankings with a perfect 5.0 score from 661 reviews. That review count is the highest in Larnaca by a wide margin and points to years of steady local work. The school is based on El Alamein street in the 6025 district, close to the western residential zones and within easy reach of the highway exits. Panikkos Iakovou is known for patient teaching with first-time learners and for clear coverage of the Cyprus theory test. Lessons usually start from quiet side streets before moving to busier routes near Finikoudes and the port. Manual and automatic cars are available, and the school handles both car and motorbike categories.
schools.f6f4ef154e90e336: G. Phidias Driving School holds a 5.0 rating from 249 reviews, making it the second most reviewed school in Larnaca. The base is on Giannou Kranidioti street in the 6046 area, a useful spot for learners living in Drosia and the eastern suburbs. Phidias is often picked by students who want a structured plan with a set number of lessons before the test. Instructors focus on the common test routes around the Larnaca examination centre, including roundabouts on Spyrou Kyprianou and the narrower lanes in the old town. Pickups from home or work are offered across the city. The school accepts car and light truck learners, and many reviews mention quick test pass rates.
schools.d58e7dba3cbf7774: Charalambos Driving School Larnaca carries a 5.0 score from 82 reviews and operates from Georgiou Averof 4 in the 6052 zone, near the centre of town. The location helps with practice on the busy commercial streets around Faneromeni and the bypass to the airport road. Charalambos is a smaller setup, which means learners often get the same instructor through the whole course. That continuity is helpful for nervous drivers or those returning to lessons after a long break. The school covers theory preparation in Greek and English and runs lessons in both manual and automatic vehicles. Evening slots are available, which suits shift workers and university students in the city.
schools.1103b3b6241a35ba: A.S. Safety Partners Ltd has a 5.0 rating from 45 reviews and works out of Trion Ierarchon 8A in the 6037 postcode. The school sits in a residential pocket close to the Larnaca general hospital, giving learners a good mix of calm streets and busier hospital traffic right from the first lesson. A.S. Safety Partners covers car licences and also offers professional driver training, which is a useful option for people moving into delivery or taxi work. Lessons are booked in flexible blocks rather than fixed packages, so learners can add hours as needed. Reviews highlight the clear safety focus and the calm approach during the practical test run-through.
schools.ec016e3ebc218731: Driving school Constantinos holds a 5.0 rating from 4 reviews and serves the 6055 area of Larnaca. The review count is small, but the feedback is consistent on patience and clear explanations of the test format. Constantinos works mostly with first-time learners who prefer a quieter, slower start. Lessons can be arranged in the surrounding streets before moving onto the main avenues that lead to the test centre. The school is a good fit for students who want a flexible schedule and a more personal feel rather than a large operation. Both manual and automatic options are usually available on request, and theory support is included with practical lessons.
schools.551917066c59c28a: ANGELOS DRIVING SCHOOL has a 5.0 rating from 2 reviews and is based at Constantinos Court on Charalambou Patsidi 03 in the 6042 district. The location is handy for learners in the eastern parts of Larnaca and those near the tourist strip. Although the review count is low, Angelos is a working option for students who want a local instructor close to home. Lessons cover the standard car category and follow the routes used by the Larnaca test centre. The school can arrange pickups from nearby streets, which saves time for learners without their own transport. New students are welcome and the booking process is simple by phone.
schools.cac5cd9d6f773c29: Scholi Odigon ANDROS holds a 3.9 rating from 7 reviews and operates from Stylianou Apostolidi 7 in the Larko Maria Building, shop 3, postcode 6021. The location is central and easy to reach from most parts of the city. Andros is one of the older names in Larnaca driving instruction, with a base that has served learners for years. The mixed feedback suggests it works well for some students and less so for others, so a short trial lesson is a sensible first step. The school covers car licences and provides theory test preparation. Booking is straightforward and the central spot makes it a practical pick for office workers in the city centre.

closing: Driving in Larnaca has a character of its own and learner drivers should know what to expect before they book their first lesson. The city centre runs around Finikoudes promenade and the streets behind it, where parking is tight and tourist foot traffic is heavy from spring through autumn. Lessons in this zone teach you to read pedestrians, taxis pulling over, and the short give-way junctions that catch out new drivers. Heading west, the Larnaca-Dhekelia road and the airport approach give a faster setting, with two lanes, sliproads, and the heavy roundabout near the salt lake. This is the kind of road that appears on test routes, so most schools build it into later lessons. The northern suburbs of Aradippou, Livadia, and Oroklini have wider streets and newer surfaces, which is helpful for early practice. The older parts of Skala and the area near Agios Lazaros church have narrow one-way systems and uneven asphalt, so manual learners often spend a lesson here to build hill-start and clutch control. Traffic in Larnaca peaks twice a day, around 7:30 to 8:30 in the morning and again from 13:00 to 14:00 when schools finish. The bypass and the road to Kiti can be slow in summer because of beach traffic. The Larnaca test centre uses a known set of routes, and good instructors will drive these with you in the final lessons. Test tips from local schools usually focus on mirror checks at every junction, full stops at stop signs, and steady speed through the roundabouts on the Spyrou Kyprianou avenue. Roads near the port can be greasy after rain, so winter learners get useful skid-awareness practice. The mix of old town, highway, and suburb in one small city means a Larnaca learner finishes the course with a wider range of skills than drivers trained in quieter towns. Pick a school close to where you live, ask about test-route practice, and book a trial hour before signing up for a full package.

faq.q: How do I start the process of getting a driving licence in Larnaca?
faq.a: First apply for a learner permit at the Department of Road Transport with your ID, a medical form, and the fee. Then book lessons with a licensed school and prepare for the theory test before the practical exam.

faq.q: How much do driving lessons cost in Larnaca in 2026?
faq.a: Single lessons usually run between 25 and 35 euro per hour. Most schools offer packages of 10 or 20 hours at a lower per-lesson rate. Automatic lessons can cost a few euro more than manual.

faq.q: How long does it take to pass the driving test in Larnaca?
faq.a: Most learners need between 15 and 25 practical hours before they are ready. With weekly lessons that means about three to five months from start to test, plus time for the theory exam.

faq.q: Can I take the driving test in English in Larnaca?
faq.a: The theory test is available in English and Greek. The practical test instructions are given in Greek, but most examiners speak basic English. Your instructor will explain the standard commands before the test.

faq.q: Where is the Larnaca driving test centre?
faq.a: The practical test is held at the Department of Road Transport office in Larnaca. Your driving school will tell you the exact meeting point and drive the common test routes with you in the final lessons.
